high_patterns.reason: The complaint describes a discrepancy in recorded marks, which may affect the student's academic record.

high_patterns.regex: \b(repeatedly|several times|multiple times|again and again|third time|second time|no response|never (replied|responded)|nobody (has )?(responded|replied)|still (not|no) (resolved|fixed|responded))\b
high_patterns.reason: The complaint indicates a repeated or unresolved issue.
An examination deadline is approaching and the issue may affect the student.
The student reports being prevented from sitting an examination.
The complaint describes a significant financial problem.
